meta.name: screen-reader-testing
meta.description: Test web applications with screen readers including VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or ensuring assistive technology support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试网页对读屏软件的兼容性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在测试网站的无障碍支持，需要验证读屏兼容性。
copy.tagline_en: Test web compatibility with screen readers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your web app works with screen readers.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按这份指南用屏幕阅读器测网页,覆盖 VoiceOver、NVDA、JAWS 等,并给出各阅读器的快捷键、测试清单和常见问题的 ARIA 修复代码。
howto.when: 当你要验证屏幕阅读器兼容性、调试辅助技术问题,或检查表单与动态内容的播报时。

say.text: 用 NVDA 的测试脚本帮我走一遍这个注册表单
say.note: 逐项检查标签、必填字段与报错播报

say.text: 这个弹窗在 VoiceOver 下读不出来,帮我看看怎么修
say.note: 给出 aria 属性与焦点管理的改法

say.text: 帮我写一份 VoiceOver 加 Safari 的页面测试清单
say.note: 按标题、landmark、链接等顺序列步骤

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude tests web pages with screen readers such as VoiceOver, NVDA and JAWS, and provides per-reader shortcut keys, testing checklists and ARIA fixes for common issues.
howto.when_en: Use it when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging assistive technology issues, or checking form and dynamic content announcements.

say_en.text: Run the NVDA test script on this signup form
say_en.note: Checks labels, required fields and errors

say_en.text: This dialog isn't read in VoiceOver, help me fix it
Write a VoiceOver with Safari checklist for this page
say_en.note: Steps through headings, landmarks and links
